title: Move an existing service to the shared Kubernetes clusters
summary: Bring a service that already runs elsewhere (virtual machines, an old container host) onto the shared Kubernetes clusters without an outage: containerise it, deploy it next to the old hosting, switch traffic, then switch the old hosting off.

prerequisites.title: Namespace on the shared clusters
prerequisites.description: The service moves into a namespace of its own, with limits sized for its current load.

prerequisites.title: Service registered in the service catalogue
prerequisites.description: Existing services often are not: the namespace and dashboards are named after the service id.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer of the team that owns the service.

actors.name: Argo CD
actors.description: Applies the manifests to the clusters.

steps.title: Check that the service can run in a container
steps.description: Most work in a move is here: what the old hosting gave the service for free must now come from the platform.
instructions: List where the service writes files and move them to a bucket or a database.
Move its settings from files on the host to environment variables or Secret Manager.
Make sure it has a health endpoint that answers when it can take traffic.
steps.outcome: List of changes the service needs before it moves

steps.title: Build a container image of the service
instructions: Add a Dockerfile from the platform template to the repository.
Let the shared build pipeline push the image to the artifact registry.
Run the image locally with the production settings and check the health endpoint.

steps.title: Add the deployment manifests
instructions: Copy the service chart from the platform template.
Set the CPU and memory requests from what the service uses today, plus 30%.
Add readiness and liveness probes on the health endpoint.
Open a pull request in the service repository.
steps.outcome: Open pull request with the manifests

steps.title: Review the manifests against the workload baseline
Fix what the review found
instructions: Read the comments on the pull request.
Push the fixes to the same branch and ask for a new review.

steps.title: Deploy to staging next to the old hosting
steps.outcome: Service running on the clusters in staging

steps.title: Compare the new deployment with the old one
instructions: Run the service's smoke tests against both.
Compare response times and error rates for a day in Grafana.
Note anything that behaves differently and fix it before production.

steps.title: Switch production traffic in a change window
instructions: Deploy to production with Argo CD while the old hosting still takes the traffic.
Move the traffic over, first 10%, then all of it, watching the error rate.
Keep the old hosting running so you can switch back.
steps.outcome: All traffic served by the clusters

steps.title: Switch the old hosting off after two quiet weeks
instructions: Check that nothing called the old hosting in the last two weeks.
Stop it, keep a backup of its data for 30 days, then delete it.
Update the service catalogue entry with the new hosting.
